en_title: GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek Reportedly Releases .exe File for Xbox Build, Sparking Concern an Unofficial PC Port Could Be Around the Corner
cn_title: 据报道，《GTA 6》泄密者Cyberleek发布XBOX版本的.exe文件，引发非官方PC移植版可能即将出现的担忧
opus_summary: 据报道，泄密者Cyberleek发布了泄露的《GTA 6》未完成XBOX版本的可执行文件，引发外界对非官方PC移植版可能很快出现的担忧。Cyberleek称其行为旨在对抗游戏行业的反消费者主义，并否认泄密只是为了推动加密货币计划。

paragraphs.en: Cyberleek has reportedly made good on their promise and released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 , sparking concern that an unofficial PC port could be around the corner.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Cyberleek兑现了承诺，发布了泄露的《GTA 6》XBOX版本的可执行文件，引发了非官方PC移植版可能即将出现的担忧。

paragraphs.en: The infamous hacker had vowed to release the .exe for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build whether the Cyberleek memecoin hit its market cap target or not , and now it is out in the wild, some within the homebrew scene are preparing to take a close look at it.
paragraphs.cn: 这名臭名昭著的黑客曾发誓，无论Cyberleek迷因币是否达到市值目标，都会发布尚未完成的《GTA 6》XBOX版本的.exe文件。如今该文件已经流出，自制软件圈内的一些人正准备对其进行仔细研究。

paragraphs.en: Cyberleek released the exe with a fresh statement insisting their actions on GTA 6 so far were about “fighting anti-consumerism in the games industry.” Cyberleek also taunts Rockstar parent company Take-Two’s so-far unsuccessful effort to prevent further leaks or, it seems, track down those responsible, saying: “Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving.”
paragraphs.cn: Cyberleek发布exe文件时发表了一份新声明，坚称其迄今针对《GTA 6》的行动是为了「对抗游戏行业中损害消费者利益的行为」。Cyberleek还嘲讽了Rockstar母公司Take-Two迄今未能成功阻止进一步泄密，或者看起来未能追查到责任人的努力，称：「经过数月的下架行动、传票和钱包追踪，追查仍在继续，上传的内容也源源不断。」

paragraphs.en: They also pushed back on claims the GTA 6 leaks are about little more than pushing a crypto scheme, insisting that crypto was used to generate funds for a secret project outside of the game. “There is no other way to move funds without names,” Cyberleek said, “and this work requires no names.”
paragraphs.cn: 他们还反驳了有关《GTA 6》泄密不过是在推销一个加密货币计划的说法，坚称加密货币是用来为游戏之外的一个秘密项目筹集资金的。Cyberleek说：「没有其他办法可以在不透露姓名的情况下转移资金，而这项工作不能涉及姓名。」

paragraphs.en: Some are now predicting that AI-assisted recompilation of the leaked Xbox build could result in GTA 6 on PC in just days, with performance improvements over the console version in weeks.
paragraphs.cn: 一些人现在预测，在AI辅助下重新编译泄露的XBOX版本，可能在短短数天内让《GTA 6》登陆PC，并在数周内实现超越主机版的性能。

paragraphs.en: This is of course a nightmare scenario for Take-Two and Sony and Microsoft, which are benefiting greatly from GTA 6 releasing on console only. The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5, and Xbox Series X and S. As a result, there is huge interest in a potential PC version offering 60fps gameplay.
paragraphs.cn: 这对Take-Two、索尼和微软来说当然是一场噩梦，因为它们正从《GTA 6》仅在主机平台发行中获得巨大利益。《GTA 6》主机版在所有平台上的目标帧率均为30fps，但在基础版PS5以及XBOX Series X和S上有时难以达到这一帧率。因此，人们对可能提供60fps游戏体验的PC版本抱有极大兴趣。

paragraphs.en: The release of the Xbox build from this month runs counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released in the summer, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch.
paragraphs.cn: 本月的XBOX版本被发布，与Cyberleek只能接触到《GTA 6》早期开发版本的看法相悖。夏季发布的视频以及游戏正式推出后显现出的差异，都强化了这种看法。

paragraphs.en: Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝呼吁人们不要在Cyberleek身上花钱，并指出这名泄密者早在8月就已套现，10月又套现了一次。对8月下旬加密货币交易的分析表明，这名《GTA 6》泄密者套现时赚取了约27万美元。

paragraphs.en: IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats.
paragraphs.cn: IGN曾报道粉丝对据称展示Jason和Lucia全裸的泄露游戏画面持怀疑态度。此前一段泄露的游戏视频据称展示了一辆坦克在游戏世界中生成，这表明有人能够使用某种开发者菜单。据称展示Jason和Lucia全裸的泄露视频还显示，NPC对此没有任何反应，这表明这一效果是通过开发者菜单或作弊手段实现的。

paragraphs.en: In the wake of Cyberleek’s initial leaks, Take-Two issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of its search for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, any potential build of the game it was taken from, or this latest Xbox build, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security.
paragraphs.cn: 在Cyberleek最初泄密之后，Take-Two向Discord等公司发出传票，作为追查责任人或责任团体的行动之一。目前仍不清楚游戏画面、这些画面可能取自的任何游戏版本，或这次最新的XBOX版本，是如何突破Rockstar出了名的严密安保措施而流出的。

paragraphs.en: In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 8月，Rockstar就《GTA 6》泄密事件作出回应，称这一情况令其开发团队「心碎」，对粉丝来说则「令人遗憾」。当时，开发商承认，其为玩家设计的体验「现在可能会受到一些剧透的影响」，但重申了《GTA 6》此前确认的11月19日发行日期。
